peg: 1.75 mm filament offcut, cut to 5 mm (2.5 in the part + 2.5 in the ship socket)

hotfin_deployed.what: Hot fin, deployed (torch): 190 x 280 x 1.6 mm panel, 13 pleat lines + heat-pipe channels both faces

hotfin_folded.what: Hot fin, folded (stowed/Metric): 190 x 20 x 6 mm stack, true scale, channels both faces

strake_loom.what: Strake, Loom 0 m: 5 mm root fill, flush with the hull (r 4.0 to 4.5)

strake_metric.what: Strake, Metric 2 m: 25 mm (5 root + 20), 3 mm accordion block, 4 pleat lines

strake_torch.what: Strake, torch 4 m: 45 mm (5 root + 40) x 1.6 mm panel, heat-pipe channels both faces

peg_test.what: Peg fit test: 6 square sockets 1.70-1.95 mm, labelled by notches; plus a 20 mm fin stub with a 1.85 socket

bay_door_leaf.what: Bay door leaf, pivoting (one STL, print 2): 138 mm long, swings 75 deg from closed to vertical on a filament pin

pivot.swing_check: leaf clears the hull shell (r 43-45 mm) from 0 to 80 deg

bay_door_leaf.pin: one 1.75 mm filament length, 144 mm: 138 through the leaf + 3 mm into each slot end wall (x 18.25 and 32.05 m on the ship)
bay_door_leaf.print: standing on end (138 mm tall), brim on, slow outer walls; pin hole 1.85 mm, tune with peg_test
bay_door_leaf.declared_exaggerations: leaf 1.6 mm (true 1.0); hinge boss 3.5 mm dia along the door edge, half proud of the skin

dropped_at_1to100: folded-stack pleat edges: 14 layers in 6 mm = 0.43 mm pitch, below the 0.5 mm minimum groove
notes: Root bar is offset to one face so every part prints flat with no supports; fin-line offset on the ship socket is 0.8-2 mm (80-200 mm real), visually nil.

Ship-side sockets belong to the whole model and are cut at the end (kT: keep the model whole); their positions are fixed here: pegs at x 40 and 150 mm along each fin from its forward end, 40 and 143 along each strake.
Bay doors pivot (kT 14 Nov). Ship-side pin holes in the slot end walls are cut with the other sockets at the end.
